description: Owner-selected release scope for the 26 exact finite numeric profiles of the successor application. Every capability keeps its declared limits and its numeric-only meaning: outputs report lean_status=NOT_EXECUTED, scientific_claims_verified=false and empirical_identification=NOT_IDENTIFIED. Lean instance replay is not part of this scope; it needs a separate, separately authenticated policy. Release authority is an owner-engineering policy (decided by the owner on 2026-11-01): the owner approves and activates a release; no independent security review is claimed or implied. Selecting this file grants nothing by itself: the owner activation stays required and is checked outside the tested artifact.

release_authority.activation: workflow_dispatch of .github/workflows/application-release.yml by the owner at the exact release commit; the release gate checks the run, its trigger and its jobs through the GitHub API
